proof_body:
by
  intro n hn
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-Real.pi) Real.pi, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (n * x) / (n:ℝ) ^ 2 - x * Real.cos (n * x) / n) (x * Real.sin (n * x)) x := by
    intro x _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (n : ℝ) * x) (n : ℝ) x := by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (n : ℝ)
    have h2 := h1.sin
    have h3 := h1.cos
    have h4 := (h2.div_const ((n:ℝ) ^ 2)).sub (((hasDerivAt_id' x).mul h3).div_const (n:ℝ))
    refine h4.congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]
  have hs : Real.sin (n * Real.pi) = 0 := Real.sin_nat_mul_pi n
  have hc : Real.cos (n * Real.pi) = (-1) ^ n := Real.cos_nat_mul_pi n
  have hs' : Real.sin (n * -Real.pi) = 0 := by rw [mul_neg, Real.sin_neg, hs, neg_zero]
  have hc' : Real.cos (n * -Real.pi) = (-1) ^ n := by rw [mul_neg, Real.cos_neg, hc]
  rw [hs, hc, hs', hc', pow_succ]
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∫ x in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, x * Real.sin (n * x) = 2 * Real.pi * (-1) ^ (n + 1) / n
